g.text: Design for a reviewed financial work product
Coatue decomposes decisions; Apollo/Redding Ridge reconciles sources; Range preserves planner review.

Coatue models investing as context transformed into selection, size and timing. Break the work into collection, interpretation, checking and judgment. A step may use code, classical ML, an LLM or a person; the objective is a sound decision process rather than maximum LLM coverage.

Apollo/Redding Ridge describes portfolio preparation for PM refinement and recurring financing reports followed by team QA. Reconciliation means learning why one feed is authoritative, not merely joining files. Define which deliverable is accepted, who checks it and which corrections remain.

Range drafts planning work while professionals serve clients; the planner reviews recommendations and the agent sends nothing. Time saved becomes valuable when it improves accepted capacity or attention to consequential judgment. Draft volume alone does not establish better advice, revenue or investment outcomes.
Sources: Coatue · Apollo / Redding Ridge / Rowspace · Range | Reviewed October 25, 2026
